bandpass.application: forward-backward SOS, zero phase; finite runs processed separately

synchronization.method: bilateral Vastus Medialis RMS vs absolute crank correlation
synchronization.assumption: Both recording applications were started together, within five seconds
synchronization.emg_envelope: 20-450 Hz band-pass then 100 ms RMS; 0.1 s bins, 0.5 s smoothing, 20 s trend removal
synchronization.limitation: Signal phase alignment is not a hardware clock measurement; muscle-to-force delay may remain
synchronization.interpolation: linear RMS interpolation at Resistance timestamps; no extrapolation; missing windows remain blank

cadence.method: positive signed-crank peaks; one same-side stroke per revolution
cadence.prominence: 0.5 * interquartile range of smoothed signed crank
cadence.interval_rule: keep intervals from 0.65 to 1.5 times that side's median; first interval unavailable
